contracts.name: Truthful Determinism
contracts.rule: Deterministic providers MUST bind output to time/input/revision/seed/runtime identity; nondeterministic providers MUST NOT claim deterministic PASS.

contracts.name: Seek Consistency
contracts.rule: Deterministic motion components MUST support order-independent seek verification within a declared tolerance.

contracts.name: Engine Selector Boundary
contracts.rule: Concrete engine preference MUST flow through FA3 Engine Selection Fabric; execution remains behind existing provider/runtime admission.

contracts.name: Resource Boundary
contracts.rule: CPU-only must remain viable and accelerator placement stays exclusively with HRB.

contracts.name: No Silent Fallback
contracts.rule: A provider/engine failure MUST NOT silently substitute another engine without approved fallback intent.

contracts.name: Render Evidence
contracts.rule: Rendered outputs MUST carry input, runtime, provider/engine intent and output digests.
